user.title: User profile
user.description: Basic profile used for the metabolic equations. Leave weight empty if you will connect a smart scale in the next step.

data_description.display_unit: Unit used for entering and displaying weight. Everything is stored internally in kg.
data_description.weight_kg: Entered in the weight unit selected above.
data_description.body_fat_percentage: Enable this if you have a smart scale that reports body composition — it unlocks the Cunningham equation.

smart_scale.title: Smart scale
smart_scale.description: Connect your smart scale to automatically update weight and body composition. Supports Withings, Xiaomi, Garmin, Fitbit, Renpho, Eufy, and any scale that exposes sensors in Home Assistant.

data.body_fat_entity: Body fat entity (% or fat mass, optional)

data_description.body_fat_entity: Accepts either a percentage sensor (%) or a fat mass sensor (kg/lb) — many scales such as Withings report fat mass. The unit of measurement is detected automatically.
data_description.scale_stale_threshold_days: Alert if the scale has not reported in this many days.

metabolic.title: Metabolic settings
metabolic.description: Mifflin-St Jeor is recommended for most people. Cunningham requires body fat data (manual or from a connected smart scale).

data_description.protein_multiplier: Grams of protein per kg of body weight.
data_description.budget_mode: Today's TDEE makes the budget rise on workout days and fall on rest days. A rolling average spreads your recent exercise evenly, giving a steadier daily target.
data_description.monthly_cycling_distance_goal: Miles or km per calendar month, matching your distance sensor's unit. Recreational baseline is ~100 miles/month. Trained athletes may target 300-600+.
data_description.weekly_aerobic_minutes_goal: ACSM recommends at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic activity per week.
data_description.monthly_strength_goal: Number of strength sessions per calendar month. ACSM recommends 2-3 per week.
data_description.weekly_rest_days_target: Passive rest days per week (1-3). Caps consecutive training days.
data_description.polarization_threshold_pct: Maximum share of high-intensity cardio sessions (last 14 days) before the engine nudges you toward low-intensity Zone 2 volume.

exercise.title: Exercise sources
exercise.description: Consumer fitness devices may overestimate calorie burn by 15-30%. Set the correction factor to 0.80-0.85 for a conservative estimate, or leave at 1.00 to use reported values as-is.

data_description.tef_percentage: Assumed TEF share of the activity multiplier. When food is logged, this share is replaced by the macro-computed TEF so it is never double-counted.
data_description.dynamic_rmr_entity: A clinical-grade metabolic device sensor. When it has reported within 24 hours it overrides all static RMR equations.

sparkyfitness.title: SparkyFitness connection
sparkyfitness.description: Connect your self-hosted SparkyFitness instance to sync food intake automatically. The API key is stored in the config entry, never logged, and redacted in diagnostics.

data_description.sparkyfitness_push_exercise: Leave OFF if SparkyFitness already receives workouts from another source (e.g. Health Connect) — a second writer would create duplicate exercise entries. Enable only when Home Assistant is the sole exercise source.

nutrition.title: Nutrition goals
nutrition.description: All targets are yours — the integration reports status against them and never prescribes an intake.

data.minimum_intake_floor_kcal: Minimum intake floor (blank = auto by sex)
data.protein_target_g_per_kg: Protein target (g per kg body weight)
data.protein_target_g_per_kg_ffm: Protein target (g per kg fat-free mass)

data_description.target_daily_deficit_kcal: Guidelines recommend a 500-750 kcal/day deficit for weight reduction. Larger deficits reduce the protective effect of dietary protein on lean mass.
data_description.minimum_intake_floor_kcal: Guideline-referenced minimums are 1200-1500 kcal/day for women and 1500-1800 kcal/day for men. Intake below this floor should be medically supervised.
data_description.protein_underreporting_correction_pct: Optional. App-based food logs have been shown to underestimate protein relative to research-grade dietary analysis. Leave at 0 unless you have a reason to correct; the raw value is always kept.
data_description.deficit_cutoff_hour: Deficit classification is suppressed before this local hour so a half-logged day is not reported as a huge deficit.
data_description.adaptive_thermogenesis_enabled: First-order approximation only: reduces TDEE by up to 15% as weight is lost from your baseline. Not individually validated.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SparkyFitness
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key was rejected. Enter a new key.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the SparkyFitness host. Check the URL and that the instance is running.
error.ssl_error: TLS certificate verification failed. Fix the certificate or disable SSL verification.
error.unexpected_schema: Connected, but the response did not look like a SparkyFitness API. Check the base URL.
error.sparkyfitness_credentials_required: Base URL and API key are required when SparkyFitness sync is enabled.
error.weight_entity_required: A weight entity is required when the smart scale is enabled.
error.weight_required: Enter a weight in the profile step or enable the smart scale.
error.cunningham_requires_body_fat: The Cunningham equation requires a body fat percentage or a mapped body fat entity.
error.peloton_calories_required: A Peloton calories entity is required when Peloton is enabled.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single Calorie Tracker instance is supported.

implausible_intake.title: Implausible intake data for today
implausible_intake.description: Today's synced intake exceeds plausibility limits (>10,000 kcal or >500 g protein). Deficit classification is suspended until the upstream food log is corrected.

options.sedentary: Sedentary — desk job, minimal daily movement
options.lightly_active: Lightly active — some walking, light daily tasks
options.moderately_active: Moderately active — on feet regularly, active job

options.fat_free_mass: Fat-free mass (g/kg FFM, needs body composition)
